approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a realistic landscape billboard mockup for a LinkedIn post. Image 1 is the bridge environment; image 2 is the exact poster to display. Expand the bridge photograph naturally into a landscape composition, preserving the recognizable Golden Gate Bridge tower, roadway, water, hills, daylight and photographic realism. Add a plausible freestanding billboard beside the bridge in the foreground, offset to one side so the main bridge tower remains visible. Use a portrait-oriented billboard face to fit the entire supplied portrait poster without cropping or stretching. Reproduce image 2's Grand Canyon poster artwork, colors, border, existing typography and all lettering as faithfully as possible, with no new text. Make the poster large and clearly visible within the landscape frame. Integrate the billboard with realistic supports, perspective, scale, daylight and shadows. Preserve the original bridge scene rather than redesigning it.
